sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Prevent missing applicability evidence from satisfying a non-applicable sh:or branch. Add top-level selection constraints outside sh:or requiring nltl:bulbousBowPresent as an xsd:boolean with sh:minCount 1 and nltl:polarClass with sh:minCount 1; retain the existing branches to distinguish false, PC1–PC5, and the applicable true/PC6-or-PC7 case. As written, PC1–PC5 ships with no bulbous-bow value, and ships with bulbousBowPresent false but no polar-class value, pass through conditional alternatives despite missing branch-selection evidence.
